message: Cover: Challenge Group B title on dark technical background.
layout_trick: Dark full-bleed cover with company and group marks, team names at the bottom.

message: Embraer at a glance: diversified operations, growth and global reach.
layout_trick: Three equal grey panels (small donut, bars with margin line, choropleth) above a full-width ribbon timeline.

message: Aging fleets and rising traffic sustain aircraft demand.
layout_trick: 2x2 with four different proofs; the value chain is a row of good isometric illustrations; delta marked at the end of the line.

message: Decades of expertise and certification record reinforce the moat.
layout_trick: 2x2 mixing ribbon timeline, ranked bars, lollipop chart and real portrait with sourced quote.

message: Mitsubishi SpaceJet shows how an entry attempt failed.
layout_trick: Competitor gets its own colour and master; wide curve timeline with real aircraft photo on top, annotated aircraft photo and committed-vs-delivered bars below.

message: Eve at a glance: air taxi built on Embraer's know-how, still in testing and burning cash.
layout_trick: Headers chained with ellipses; wedge opens from the aircraft image into three items; roadmap as isometric steps with text inside.

message: Eve is a funded bet: its liquidity and Embraer's cash flow can carry the burn.
layout_trick: Two wide pale panels linked by a narrow grey fold; dashed box over the uses; two anchored callouts with the ratio.

message: Executive jets are a fleet-driven growth engine with a lean lineup.
layout_trick: Product ladder: rising dark steps with real jet photos on top and specs below, next to bars and a combo chart.

message: Record backlog meets a faster delivery pace.
layout_trick: Clean 2x2; short wedge from the last column opens into the composition of that same number, in a dashed box.

message: Critical suppliers and a few airlines hold leverage.
layout_trick: 2x2 with pale panels and fold in the top row; bracket sums top customers with a short anchored label; annotated jet photo.

message: The E175 is the only 70-90 seat jet for sale in the West.
layout_trick: Three stepped product cards with real photos, spec bullets and an 'edge' strip; the focus card is dark.

message: Small narrowbody jets: Embraer vs Airbus side by side.
layout_trick: Two columns of product cards with fold between stacked planes; dark for the focus company, pale for the rival.

message: Scope clauses protect the E175 and cap growth.
layout_trick: Spine of icon rows ending in a dashed link to a compliant vs above-scope card pair and a real material-fact excerpt.

message: Few rivals, mostly larger: Embraer leads its niches.
layout_trick: Chained headers; stacked bars and small donut on the left; four 'vs' cards with real photos on the right.
